title: vatica canaliculata
intro: Vatica canaliculata, commonly known as the Malayan ironwood or Malaysian ironwood, is a species of evergreen tree belonging to the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Vatica canaliculata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Vatica canaliculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
